videos.title: Add a product
videos.summary: A new toy from the first field to the website: category, name, price, stock, pictures and the Active status.
steps: Open Products and press Add product
Choose the category, and the sub-category if there is one
Type the product name. The SKU is made for you
Write a short description and the full description
Set the status to Active. Only Active products show on the website
Under Options and pricing type the old price, the price and the stock
Add pictures. The first one is the main picture
Press Add product to save
Done. The product is in the list. The website shows it after the next rebuild, 1 to 3 minutes

videos.title: Edit a product
videos.summary: Find a product, change its status from the list, then change its price and stock, and add another option.
steps: Find the product with the search box
Change the status right in the list. Inactive hides the product, Active shows it
Press the pencil to open the product
Go to Options and pricing. Open it if it is closed
Change the price. The old price has to be higher than the price
Change the stock when you receive or sell toys
Need a second size or colour? Press Add option and fill it in
Press Save product
Saved. Customers pay the price shown in the cart, and it is live at once on the product page

videos.title: Categories and sub-categories
videos.summary: Add a category, then a sub-category inside it. Products are placed in them when you add or edit a product.
steps: Open Categories and press Add category
Type the name of the category
Active shows it on the website. Top puts it on the home page (the list shows how many fit)
Press Save
To add a sub-category, press the + next to the category
Type the name of the sub-category and press Save
Done. Use the pencil to rename a category, or the switch to hide it from the website

videos.title: Add a discount
videos.summary: A discount lowers prices by itself, with no code. Choose how much, on what, and for how long.
steps: Open Discounts and press Add discount
Name the discount. Only you see this name
Choose Percentage or Fixed amount, then type the value
Choose what it applies to: the whole store, or chosen categories or products
Search and click the categories to add
Starts and Ends are optional. Leave them empty to start now and never end
Press Add discount. The new price shows on the website and in the cart
Done. Switch Active off in the list to stop a discount without deleting it

videos.title: Add a coupon
videos.summary: A coupon is a code customers type at checkout. Set the code, the amount, and limits such as a minimum order.
steps: Open Coupons and press Add coupon
Type the code customers will enter. Letters and digits, no spaces
Give it a name for yourself
Choose Percentage or Fixed amount, then type the value
It works on the whole store here. You can also choose categories or products
Set limits: a minimum order, how many times it can be used, and uses per customer
Free delivery and First order only are switches in the same form
Press Add coupon
Done. Tell your customers the code. Switch it off in the list when the offer ends

videos.title: Settings
videos.summary: A tour of Settings: your contact details, delivery, payments and notifications, and how to save a change.
steps: Settings has one tab for each topic. Start with General
Your phone, WhatsApp number and e-mail show on the website, in e-mails and on invoices
Press Save changes. The bar at the bottom shows when something is not saved
Delivery: choose how the fee is worked out, and the amounts
Payments: switch cash on delivery and bank transfer on or off, and add your bank accounts
The IBAN is optional. It is shown to customers only when you fill it in
Notifications: who is told by e-mail and on this device when an order arrives
Every change shows on the website after the next rebuild, about 1 to 3 minutes
